description: A minimalist wooden dining table with a rectangular top and four tapered legs. The table is made of light-colored wood, likely oak or ash, and features a clean, unfussy design. The tabletop has a subtle grain pattern, and the legs are angled outwards, giving it a light and airy feel. The table appears to be extendable, with a visible seam down the center of the tabletop. This design makes it a versatile piece for various dining spaces, easily accommodating different needs.
